observation_age_minutes.meaning: age of the most recent pool observation at the vulnerable pool checkpoint

observation_history_insufficient.meaning: pool has insufficient observation history for the TWAP query

owner_tx_pending.meaning: an owner-initiated liquidity operation transaction targeting the vulnerable pool is pending in the mempool

attacker_capital_available.meaning: attacker has flash loan capital available for price manipulation, reversible via back-run, plus gas costs

price_validated_against_twap.meaning: the liquidity operation validated the current pool price against the 30-minute TWAP rather than using the unvalidated spot price

sequential_operations_compounded.meaning: multiple sequential liquidity operations on different vulnerable pools occur, compounding the economic damage
sequential_operations_compounded.checkpoint: after owner liquidity operations across vulnerable pools

assumptions: The owner liquidity operation is a mint/rebalance that derives tick ranges from the price returned by checkPoolAndGetCenterPrice.
The attacker's front-run swap and back-run restore are feasible within the same block ordering as the pending owner transaction.
Each vulnerable pool independently satisfies the stale-or-insufficient-observation condition.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the concrete liquidity operation type (mint, rebalance, etc.) nor numeric swap size or tick shifts, so the compounding scenario is only qualitatively bounded.
Report does not define a numeric measure of 'economic damage' or how damage across sequential operations aggregates, so compounding is represented only as a qualitative occurrence flag.

limitations: Formalizes only the compounded_economic_damage impact; other listed impacts (out-of-range position, fee loss, gas costs, impermanent loss, opportunity cost) are handled in separate passes.
The compounding relation is qualitative because the report supplies no numeric damage aggregation formula.
The scenario is conditional/potential in the report; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario rather than an inevitable outcome.
